日文.词条标题: 秋田内陸縦貫鉄道AN-8800形気動車
日文.首段: 秋田内陸縦貫鉄道AN-8800形気動車（あきたないりくじゅうかんてつどうAN8800がたきどうしゃ）は、秋田内陸縦貫鉄道が保有する気動車である。

章节.概要:
秋田内陸縦貫鉄道では秋田内陸線全通までの暫定措置として国鉄からキハ22形を9両借り入れて運行したが、キハ22形は国鉄時代に冬期の単行運転の実績がないうえ老朽化が進行しており、故障が頻発したため、全線開業を待たず1988年2月に新潟鐵工所で9両（AN-8801 - 8809）が製造された。
前面貫通構造、両運転台の軽快気動車である。
章节.構造:
新潟鐵工所のローカル線向け軽快気動車であるNDCシリーズの一員で、車体長18.5m。同世代にあたる若桜鉄道のWT2500形（現WT3000形）と基本仕様は共通しているが、寒冷地への投入のため乗客用扉が引戸になっている。車内はセミクロスシートでトイレ、ワンマン運転対応設備を有する。定員120名（座席60名）。
車体塗装の塗り分けはそれまでのキハ22形に準じるが、地色がクリーム色からアイボリーに変更された。その後8804以外の車両が1両ごとに異なった塗装に変更されている。 
走行用機関として直噴式の6H13AS(250 PS / 1900 rpm)ディーゼルエンジンを床下に1基搭載し、前位側台車の2軸を駆動する。台車は動台車がNP120D、従台車がNP120Tで、いずれも枕ばねは空気ばねである。また、冷房装置としてAU26(22000 kcal/h)を1基搭載する。
8808は、2003年にカラオケを装備するお座敷列車に改造され、桜と紅葉の絵柄をラッピングした外観となった。2018年4月には「マタギ号」としてリニューアルを受けた。さらに2022年4月には「走るマタギの古民家」がコンセプトの「秋田マタギ号」として再リニューアルされ、車内はテーブル付きの4人掛けボックスシートとなった。
2023年より、前面窓内にLED前照灯増設改造が順次実施されている。
章节.運用:
当初は秋田内陸北線（旧阿仁合線）と秋田内陸南線（旧角館線）の両方に投入され、全通により秋田内陸線全線で普通列車の運用を開始した。2012年以降はAN-8900形に代わって急行列車にも使用されている。
8808は前述のお座敷化改造以後、主に貸切・イベント列車で運用されていた。その後「秋田マタギ号」に再々改造された2022年4月からは、第1・2・4・5土曜日に急行「もりよし」で運行されている。
2025年（令和7年）12月12日、荒瀬駅 - 萱草駅間を走行していた8806が脱線し転覆。乗客は乗っておらず、男性運転士が負傷した。当該車両である8806は、吊り上げが困難なことから現地で解体されることとなった。
章节.カラーリング: 当初は全車が白地に赤帯の内陸線標準色だったが、2022年3月31日現在全車がそれぞれ違う塗装となっている。
章节.秋田犬っこ列車:
2016年（平成28年）12月から行われているラッピングである。外装は、先行の8805 - 8809号車は秋田犬と沿線の景勝地のイラスト、後から改装した8801 - 8803号車は沿線のお祭りのイラストが絵柄となっている。
秋田犬を基調とした内外装となっており、秋田犬の写真展示や犬柄のモケットといった特徴がある。

中文.词条标题: 秋田内陆纵贯铁道AN-8800型柴油动车组
中文.首段: 秋田内陆纵贯铁道AN-8800型柴油动车组（あきたないりくじゅうかんてつどうAN8800がたきどうしゃ）是秋田内陆纵贯铁道保有的柴油动车组。

章节.概要:
秋田内陆纵贯铁道在秋田内陆线全线通车之前的临时措施中，从国铁借入9辆キハ22型运行，但キハ22型在国铁时代没有冬季单行运行的实绩，且老化加剧，故障频发，因此在全线开业之前，于1988年2月由新潟铁工所制造了9辆（AN-8801 - 8809）。
这是前面贯通结构、双驾驶台的轻快柴油动车组。
章节.结构:
是新潟铁工所面向地方线路的轻快柴油动车组NDC系列的一员，车体长18.5m。与同世代的若樱铁道WT2500型（现WT3000型）基本规格相同，但因投入寒冷地区，乘客用门改为推拉门。车内为半交叉式座椅，设有厕所及单人运转对应设备。定员120名（座席60名）。
车体涂装的涂分沿袭此前的キハ22型，但底色由奶油色改为象牙色。此后除8804以外的车辆每辆都改为各不相同的涂装。
作为行驶用发动机，在车下搭载1台直喷式6H13AS（250 PS / 1900 rpm）柴油发动机，驱动前位侧转向架的2轴。转向架为动力转向架NP120D、从动转向架NP120T，两者枕簧均为空气弹簧。此外，作为冷气装置搭载1台AU26（22000 kcal/h）。
8808于2003年被改造为装备卡拉OK的座敷列车（宴会列车），外观包裹了樱花与红叶图案。2018年4月作为“マタギ号”接受更新。进而于2022年4月，以“奔跑的猎人古民家”为概念再更新为“秋田マタギ号”，车内成为带桌子的4人包厢座席。
自2023年起，正在依次实施在前面窗内增设LED前照灯的改造。
章节.运用:
最初投入秋田内陆北线（旧阿仁合线）和秋田内陆南线（旧角馆线）双方，随着全线通车，开始在秋田内陆线全线运行普通列车。2012年以后，代替AN-8900型也用于急行列车。
8808在前述座敷化改造以后，主要运用于包租、活动列车。此后在再改造为“秋田マタギ号”的2022年4月起，于第1、2、4、5个星期六以急行“もりよし”运行。
2025年（令和7年）12月12日，正在荒濑站～萱草站间行驶的8806脱轨并翻覆。车上没有乘客，男性司机受伤。该车辆8806因难以吊起，决定在现地解体。
章节.配色: 当初全车为白底红带的内陆线标准色，但截至2022年3月31日，全车各自成为不同的涂装。
章节.秋田犬小列车:
这是自2016年（平成28年）12月起进行的包裹广告。外装方面，先行的8805 - 8809号车为秋田犬与沿线名胜的插图，后改装的8801 - 8803号车以沿线祭典的插图为图案。
以秋田犬为基调的内外装，具有展示秋田犬照片、犬纹座椅面料等特征。

英文.词条标题: Akita Nairiku Jūkan Railway AN-8800 series diesel railcar
英文.首段: The Akita Nairiku Jūkan Railway AN-8800 series diesel railcar (あきたないりくじゅうかんてつどうAN8800がたきどうしゃ) is a diesel railcar owned by Akita Nairiku Jūkan Railway.

章节.Overview:
On the Akita Nairiku Jūkan Railway, as a provisional measure until the full opening of the Akita Nairiku Line, nine KiHa 22 type cars were borrowed from Japanese National Railways and operated, but because the KiHa 22 type had no record of single-car operation in winter during the JNR era and was progressively aging, breakdowns occurred frequently; therefore, before the opening of the entire line, nine cars (AN-8801 to 8809) were built by Niigata Tekkōsho in February 1988.
It is a lightweight diesel railcar with a front gangway structure and cabs at both ends.
章节.Structure:
It is a member of the NDC series of lightweight diesel railcars for local lines by Niigata Tekkōsho, with a body length of 18.5 m. Its basic specifications are common with the contemporaneous Wakasa Railway WT2500 type (now WT3000 type), but because it was introduced into a cold region the passenger doors are sliding doors. The interior has semi-cross seating and is equipped with a toilet and facilities for one-man operation. Capacity is 120 (60 seats).
The livery's color separation follows the previous KiHa 22 type, but the base color was changed from cream to ivory. Afterwards, all cars except 8804 were changed to a different livery for each car.
As the running engine, one direct-injection 6H13AS (250 PS / 1900 rpm) diesel engine is mounted under the floor, driving the two axles of the leading bogie. The bogies are NP120D for the powered bogie and NP120T for the trailing bogie, both with air springs as bolster springs. One AU26 (22,000 kcal/h) is also mounted as an air-conditioning unit.
8808 was rebuilt in 2003 into a tatami (ozashiki) train equipped with karaoke, and its exterior was wrapped with a design of cherry blossoms and autumn leaves. In April 2018 it was renewed as the "Matagi-go." Furthermore, in April 2022 it was renewed again as the "Akita Matagi-go" with the concept of a "running matagi's traditional house," and the interior became four-person box seats with tables.
Since 2023, work to add LED headlights inside the front windows has been carried out successively.
章节.Operation:
Initially it was introduced on both the Akita Nairiku North Line (former Aniai Line) and the Akita Nairiku South Line (former Kakunodate Line), and with the full opening it began operating local trains over the entire Akita Nairiku Line. Since 2012 it has also been used for express trains in place of the AN-8900 type.
After the aforementioned ozashiki conversion, 8808 was mainly operated on charter and event trains. Then, from April 2022 when it was rebuilt again as the "Akita Matagi-go," it has been operated on the express "Moriyoshi" on the 1st, 2nd, 4th, and 5th Saturdays.
On December 12, 2025 (Reiwa 7), 8806, which was running between Arase Station and Kayakusa Station, derailed and overturned. No passengers were aboard, and the male driver was injured. The car concerned, 8806, was to be dismantled on site because it was difficult to lift.
章节.Coloring: Initially all cars were in the inland line standard color of white with a red band, but as of March 31, 2022, every car has a different livery.
章节.Akita Inukko Train:
This is a wrapping carried out since December 2016 (Heisei 28). For the exterior, the earlier cars 8805 to 8809 have illustrations of Akita dogs and scenic spots along the line, and the later-refurbished cars 8801 to 8803 have illustrations of festivals along the line as their designs.
The interior and exterior are based on the Akita dog, and are characterized by displays of Akita dog photographs and dog-patterned seat upholstery.

The Akita Nairiku Jūkan Railway AN-8800 series diesel railcar (あきたないりくじゅうかんてつどうAN8800がたきどうしゃ) is a diesel railcar owned by Akita Nairiku Jūkan Railway.

== Overview ==
On the Akita Nairiku Jūkan Railway, as a provisional measure until the full opening of the Akita Nairiku Line, nine KiHa 22 type cars were borrowed from Japanese National Railways and operated, but because the KiHa 22 type had no record of single-car operation in winter during the JNR era and was progressively aging, breakdowns occurred frequently; therefore, before the opening of the entire line, nine cars (AN-8801 to 8809) were built by Niigata Tekkōsho in February 1988.
It is a lightweight diesel railcar with a front gangway structure and cabs at both ends.

== Structure ==
It is a member of the NDC series of lightweight diesel railcars for local lines by Niigata Tekkōsho, with a body length of 18.5 m. Its basic specifications are common with the contemporaneous Wakasa Railway WT2500 type (now WT3000 type), but because it was introduced into a cold region the passenger doors are sliding doors. The interior has semi-cross seating and is equipped with a toilet and facilities for one-man operation. Capacity is 120 (60 seats).
The livery's color separation follows the previous KiHa 22 type, but the base color was changed from cream to ivory. Afterwards, all cars except 8804 were changed to a different livery for each car.
As the running engine, one direct-injection 6H13AS (250 PS / 1900 rpm) diesel engine is mounted under the floor, driving the two axles of the leading bogie. The bogies are NP120D for the powered bogie and NP120T for the trailing bogie, both with air springs as bolster springs. One AU26 (22,000 kcal/h) is also mounted as an air-conditioning unit.
8808 was rebuilt in 2003 into a tatami (ozashiki) train equipped with karaoke, and its exterior was wrapped with a design of cherry blossoms and autumn leaves. In April 2018 it was renewed as the "Matagi-go." Furthermore, in April 2022 it was renewed again as the "Akita Matagi-go" with the concept of a "running matagi's traditional house," and the interior became four-person box seats with tables.
Since 2023, work to add LED headlights inside the front windows has been carried out successively.

== Operation ==
Initially it was introduced on both the Akita Nairiku North Line (former Aniai Line) and the Akita Nairiku South Line (former Kakunodate Line), and with the full opening it began operating local trains over the entire Akita Nairiku Line. Since 2012 it has also been used for express trains in place of the AN-8900 type.
After the aforementioned ozashiki conversion, 8808 was mainly operated on charter and event trains. Then, from April 2022 when it was rebuilt again as the "Akita Matagi-go," it has been operated on the express "Moriyoshi" on the 1st, 2nd, 4th, and 5th Saturdays.
On December 12, 2025 (Reiwa 7), 8806, which was running between Arase Station and Kayakusa Station, derailed and overturned. No passengers were aboard, and the male driver was injured. The car concerned, 8806, was to be dismantled on site because it was difficult to lift.

== Coloring ==
Initially all cars were in the inland line standard color of white with a red band, but as of March 31, 2022, every car has a different livery.

== Body wrapping ==

=== Akita Inukko Train ===
This is a wrapping carried out since December 2016 (Heisei 28). For the exterior, the earlier cars 8805 to 8809 have illustrations of Akita dogs and scenic spots along the line, and the later-refurbished cars 8801 to 8803 have illustrations of festivals along the line as their designs.
The interior and exterior are based on the Akita dog, and are characterized by displays of Akita dog photographs and dog-patterned seat upholstery.
